changes.before: 頑固な糞をひり出すみたいに意地を張って
changes.after: 硬い糞をひり出すみたいに意地を張って
changes.reason: 「拉硬屎」の硬い便という田舎言葉の比喩を残す。「頑固な糞」は不自然な擬人化だった。

changes.before: まあ、何年もたたないのに、もう忘れてしまうなんて。
changes.after: まあ、何年ぶりになるでしょう、もう忘れてしまいましたよ。
changes.reason: 「能几年，我就忘了」は経過年数を思い出せない口ぶり。「何年もたたない」と期間を限定しない。

changes.before: 金色の心に緑がきらめく繻子
changes.after: 金色を帯びて緑にきらめく繻子
changes.reason: 調度の色を保持しつつ、「金色の心」という意味の通らない逐語訳を自然にする。織り方・文様は追加しない。

assessment.completeness: All 42 included blocks read against their embedded Chinese source; no substantive omissions found within the permitted excerpt. Does not assess or claim the whole chapter.
assessment.meaning: Fixed the elapsed-years misunderstanding in block 16. The narrator’s frame, borrowed kinship, hardship, servant mediation, household spectacle, gift and departure remain intact.
assessment.kinship: Verified the invented clan tie, 王夫人’s elder brother as 鳳姐’s father, 狗児 and his wife 劉氏, maternal grandmother 劉姥姥, 青児/板児 as きょうだい, and the deliberately awkward 「お宅の甥」. 「老舅太太」 as 鳳姐’s mother is retained with the draft note; not generalized to other occurrences.
assessment.dialogue: Retains the rural grandmother’s frankness, 狗児’s impatience, 周瑞の女房’s gatekeeping, and 鳳姐’s polished condescension. Two minor naturalness edits made.
assessment.poetry: Both final couplet lines checked; their block kind and boundaries are unchanged.
